items.name: Committer
items.summary: A Committer is the system by which transactions are committed to a table. Transactions are effectively a collection of actions performed on the table at a specific version. The kernel exposes this trait so different catalogs can build thei…

methods.name: commit
methods.signature: fn commit(&self, engine: &dyn Engine, actions: DeltaResultIterator<'_, FilteredEngineData>, commit_metadata: CommitMetadata) -> DeltaResult<CommitResponse>
methods.summary: Commits actions to the table at the version specified in [`CommitMetadata`].

methods.name: is_catalog_committer
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this committer is for a catalog-managed table, else `false`.

methods.name: publish
methods.signature: fn publish(&self, engine: &dyn Engine, publish_metadata: PublishMetadata) -> DeltaResult<()>
methods.summary: Publishes catalog commits to the Delta log. Applicable only to catalog-managed tables.
